ability.aura.ice.name: Ice
ability.aura.ice.description: Increases ice magic resistance and ice magic damage
ability.aura.ice_nova.name: Aura
ability.aura.ice_nova.description: Cast a ice aura for a duration, slows and damages all enemies in a radius
ability.aura.ice_burst.name: Burst
ability.aura.ice_burst.description: Fires a forward spread of ice projectiles.
ability.aura.ice_implode.name: Implode
ability.aura.ice_implode.description: Creates an explosion slows all enemies
ability.aura.ice_pierce.name: Pierce
ability.aura.ice_pierce.description: Launches an ice projectile with piercing
ability.aura.ice_glacier.name: Glacier
ability.aura.ice_glacier.description: Strikes nearby enemies with heavy ice damage and strong slow.
ability.aura.ice_storm.name: Storm
ability.aura.ice_storm.description: Creates a storm that repeatedly pelts nearby enemies with ice while active.
ability.aura.lightning.name: Lightning
ability.aura.lightning.description: Increases lightning magic resistance and lightning magic damage, effect mobs with electrocuted: +10% speed -10% damage
ability.aura.lightning_nova.name: Aura
ability.aura.lightning_nova.description: Sends repeated lightning pulses from you for a duration, shocking enemies in range.
ability.aura.lightning_zap.name: Zap
ability.aura.lightning_zap.description: Chains weak lightning hits into multiple nearby enemies.
ability.aura.lightning_implode.name: ThunderClap
ability.aura.lightning_implode.descripti: Creates a charged explosion, electrocuting all enemies
ability.aura.lightning_strike.name: Strike
ability.aura.lightning_strike.descriptio: Calls a focused lightning strike on one enemy in front of you.
ability.aura.lightning_storm.name: Storm
ability.aura.lightning_storm.description: Creates a storm that repeatedly zaps nearby enemies while active.
ability.aura.poison.name: Poison
ability.aura.poison.description: Increases poison magic resistance and poison magic damage
ability.aura.poison_nova.name: Aura
ability.aura.poison_nova.description: Cast a poison aura for a duration, poisoning all enemies in a radius
ability.aura.poison_burst.name: Burst
ability.aura.poison_burst.description: Cast a burst of poison projectiles
ability.aura.poison_implode.name: Implode
ability.aura.poison_implode.description: Creates an explosion and poisons all enemies
ability.aura.force.name: Force
ability.aura.force.description: Increases force magic resistance and force magic damage
ability.aura.aegis.name: Aegis
ability.aura.aegis.description: Grants one persistent charge per Force level. Each charge reduces incoming damage by 10% per Force level and breaks when it absorbs a hit. The cooldown starts after the last charge breaks.
ability.aura.blast.name: Burst
ability.aura.blast.description: Creates a force explosion that damages and knocks back nearby enemies
ability.aura.shockwave.name: Shockwave
ability.aura.shockwave.description: Sends a widening wave of force forward, damaging and knocking back enemies in its path.
ability.aura.rampage.name: Rampage
ability.aura.rampage.description: Applies the Rampaging effect for a duration, boosting melee pressure while active.
ability.aura.blood.name: Blood
ability.aura.blood.description: Increases blood magic resistance and blood magic damage
ability.aura.heal.name: Heal
ability.aura.heal.description: Restores a chunk of your health instantly
ability.aura.cleanse.name: Cleanse
ability.aura.cleanse.description: Removes harmful effects, extinguishes fire, restores health, and grants one minute of fire resistance
ability.aura.blood-burst.name: Burst
ability.aura.blood-burst.description: Consumes your health and fires it as equal-damage blood projectiles
ability.aura.blood_beam.name: Drain
ability.aura.blood_beam.description: Locks onto an enemy, slowly draining health and returning half as healing
ability.aura.wind.name: Wind
ability.aura.wind.description: Increases wind magic resistance and wind magic damage
ability.aura.dash.name: Dash
ability.aura.dash.description: Dash forward with a small lift to clear ledges.
ability.aura.leap.name: Leap
ability.aura.leap.description: Leap forward, then jump once more in mid-air. At max level, jump twice more. Its cooldown starts after the last extra jump.
ability.aura.lunge.name: Lunge
ability.aura.lunge.description: Launch forward and create a small damaging shockwave when you land.
ability.aura.ultimate-soulfire.name: Soulfire
ability.aura.ultimate-soulfire.descripti: Soulfire burns longer and deals double damage
ability.aura.ultimate-soulfire_aura.name: Aura
ability.aura.ultimate-soulfire_aura.desc: Sends repeated soulfire pulses outward, dealing double aura damage and longer burns.
ability.aura.ultimate-soulfire_burst.des: Fires extra, stronger blue projectiles with a soulfire trail.
ability.aura.ultimate-soulfire_blast.des: Explodes around you, burning enemies with soulfire and blasting them away.
ability.aura.ultimate-soulfire_storm.des: Creates an improved storm cloud that rains soulfire on nearby enemies.
ability.aura.ultimate-permafrost.name: Permafrost
ability.aura.ultimate-permafrost.descrip: Final ice form. Ice hits apply Permafrost, freezing movement after three seconds.
ability.aura.ultimate-permafrost_aura.de: Sends freezing pulses outward and applies Permafrost to enemies.
ability.aura.ultimate-permafrost_burst.d: Fires additional freezing projectiles that apply Permafrost.
ability.aura.ultimate-permafrost_blast.d: Pulls enemies into an icy blast and applies Permafrost.
Launches an additional piercing ice shot every two levels and applies Permafrost.
ability.aura.ultimate-permafrost_glacier: Crushes nearby enemies with glacial damage and Permafrost.
ability.aura.ultimate-permafrost_storm.d: Creates an improved storm that repeatedly applies Permafrost.
ability.aura.ultimate-plasma.name: Plasma
ability.aura.ultimate-plasma.description: Final lightning form. Lightning hits deal more damage and trigger secondary plasma explosions.
ability.aura.ultimate-plasma_aura.name: Aura
ability.aura.ultimate-plasma_aura.descri: Sends plasma pulses outward, triggering secondary explosions around struck enemies.
ability.aura.ultimate-plasma_burst.name: Burst
ability.aura.ultimate-plasma_burst.descr: Chains empowered plasma into nearby enemies with secondary explosions.
ability.aura.ultimate-plasma_blast.name: Blast
ability.aura.ultimate-plasma_blast.descr: Pulls enemies inward before detonating plasma around each target.
ability.aura.ultimate-plasma_strike.name: Strike
ability.aura.ultimate-plasma_strike.desc: Calls an empowered strike followed by a plasma explosion.
ability.aura.ultimate-plasma_storm.name: Storm
ability.aura.ultimate-plasma_storm.descr: Creates an improved storm that repeatedly detonates plasma among enemies.
ability.aura.ultimate-toxin.name: Toxin
ability.aura.ultimate-toxin.description: Final poison form. Poison abilities inflict lethal Toxin instead.
ability.aura.ultimate-toxin_aura.name: Aura
ability.aura.ultimate-toxin_aura.descrip: Sends toxic pulses outward that inflict lethal Toxin.
ability.aura.ultimate-toxin_burst.name: Burst
ability.aura.ultimate-toxin_burst.descri: Fires additional projectiles that inflict lethal Toxin.
ability.aura.ultimate-toxin_blast.name: Blast
ability.aura.ultimate-toxin_blast.descri: Pulls nearby enemies into a blast of lethal Toxin.
ability.aura.ultimate-singularity.name: Singularity
ability.aura.ultimate-singularity.descri: Final force form. Force abilities push farther and resist more damage.
Grants persistent Singularity charges that reduce incoming damage until every charge is destroyed.
ability.aura.ultimate-singularity_implod: Creates a stronger force explosion with greatly increased knockback.
ability.aura.ultimate-singularity_shockw: Sends a wider, longer singularity wave forward with increased damage and knockback.
ability.aura.ultimate-singularity_rampag: Deals more melee damage and defers incoming damage until Rampage ends, leaving at least half a heart.
ability.aura.ultimate-bloodfire.name: Bloodfire
ability.aura.ultimate-bloodfire.descript: Final blood form. Blood abilities ignite enemies and gain powerful support effects.
ability.aura.ultimate-bloodfire-heal.des: Heals you, grants ten seconds of fire resistance, and ignites enemies within five blocks.
Transfers your harmful effects to enemies within four blocks and ignites them.
ability.aura.ultimate-bloodfire-burst.de: Fires health-powered blood projectiles that ignite enemies on impact.
ability.aura.ultimate-bloodfire-beam.des: Drains an enemy while continuously setting it alight.
ability.aura.ultimate-tempest.name: Tempest
ability.aura.ultimate-tempest.descriptio: Final wind form. Wind abilities are stronger and create four wind-charge blasts.
ability.aura.ultimate-tempest_dash.name: Dash
ability.aura.ultimate-tempest_dash.descr: Dashes farther and creates four wind-charge blasts.
ability.aura.ultimate-tempest_leap.name: Leap
ability.aura.ultimate-tempest_leap.descr: Leaps farther and creates four wind-charge blasts.
ability.aura.ultimate-tempest_lunge.name: Lunge
ability.aura.ultimate-tempest_lunge.desc: Lunges farther and creates four wind-charge blasts.
